propositions: Generic read-under-contention property currently accepts shape-valid but content-hollow payloads (missing ticket_id) on all four surfaces (show/list/search/ready).
Faults F3 (show emits {} with exit 0) and F6 (show emits record without ticket_id with exit 0) pass generic tests but fail the original regression test, exposing a detection gap.
Content-completeness predicate must be added per-surface: show requires truthy ticket_id on returned object; list/search/ready require all dict elements to carry truthy ticket_id.
Strengthened assertion is added only to _assert_complete_or_loud after shape check, with no new subprocess calls, rounds, or fixtures.
Valid-empty list [] must remain passing (all() vacuously true over empty iterable) to distinguish from truncated output.
